lead.headline: Institutional Rails Converge on Stablecoins and Perps
lead.tldr: The gap between TradFi and Web3 is narrowing as CBOE eyes perpetuals and Chainlink integrates with global banking groups for FX settlement.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is today's intelligence brief on the institutionalization of crypto primitives and the tightening of regulatory nets.

top_signals.title: DOJ seizes Huione Group cloud computing account used to launder billions in fraud proceeds
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice has seized a cloud computing account belonging to Huione Group used to facilitate the laundering of billions in fraud proceeds. This follows a previous designation by FinCEN identifying the group as a primary money laundering concern.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Increased DOJ aggression against large-scale laundering hubs signals a shift toward targeting the infrastructure of fraud rather than just individual actors.

top_signals.title: CBOE Eyes Crypto Perpetual Futures After CFTC Shift
top_signals.summary: CBOE is exploring the launch of crypto perpetual futures following a regulatory shift by the CFTC regarding Kalshi's products. This move comes as traditional finance entities and crypto exchanges like Coinbase continue to expand their perpetual trading offerings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: CBOE's interest in perpetuals suggests a regulatory thaw that could bring massive institutional liquidity to the most popular crypto derivative product.

top_signals.title: Chainlink Joins Banks to Develop Stablecoin FX Settlement
top_signals.summary: Chainlink is collaborating with banking groups from Europe and South Korea to develop stablecoin-powered foreign exchange (FX) settlements. This initiative, known as Project Pangea, aims to modernize cross-border payments using blockchain technology.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Project Pangea validates the shift from speculative stablecoin use to core banking utility in the trillion-dollar FX market.

top_signals.title: Tether-backed Oobit brings USDT to nearly 170 million users of Brazil’s PIX payment network
top_signals.summary: Oobit, backed by Tether, is integrating USDT into Brazil's PIX payment network, potentially granting 170 million users access to the stablecoin. This move leverages one of the world's most widely adopted digital payment systems to increase USDT utility in South America.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Integrating USDT into Brazil's PIX network represents a massive scale-up in stablecoin distribution via existing national payment rails.

top_signals.title: EU committee advances digital euro bill after key vote3m, EU committee advances digital euro bill after key voteEU lawmakers backed rules for an offline and online digital euro, with privacy safeguards, holding limits and no interest payments.
top_signals.summary: EU lawmakers have advanced a bill establishing rules for a digital euro, covering both online and offline functionality. The proposal includes specific privacy safeguards, holding limits, and a mandate that the currency will not pay interest.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The digital euro's progress establishes a blueprint for CBDCs that prioritizes privacy and limits over monetary incentive.

deals.summary: Crypto analytics startup Allium has raised $40 million in a Series B funding round to provide blockchain data solutions for institutional investors. The round was led by Amplify Partners with participation from Kleiner Perkins and Theory Ventures.

on_the_radar.title: Ripple Secures Preliminary MiCA Approval Ahead of EU Deadline
on_the_radar.summary: Ripple has obtained preliminary MiCA approval in Luxembourg, positioning the company for expansion within the European Union. This move comes ahead of the July 1 regulatory transition deadline for crypto-asset service providers.

on_the_radar.title: Ethereum Foundation Lays off 54 Employees as Buterin Reveals 40% Budget Cut
on_the_radar.summary: The Ethereum Foundation has implemented a major restructuring resulting in the layoff of 54 employees. Vitalik Buterin further disclosed that the organization's budget will be reduced by approximately 40%.

on_the_radar.title: US Senate passes housing bill with CBDC ban until 203032m, US Senate passes housing bill with CBDC ban until 2030The Senate voted 85-5 to pass a major housing affordability bill that includes a ban on the Federal Reserve making a central bank digital currency until 2030.
on_the_radar.summary: The US Senate passed a housing affordability bill that includes a specific provision banning the Federal Reserve from issuing a central bank digital currency (CBDC) until 2030. The bill passed with a significant majority of 85-5.

on_the_radar.title: CFTC sues Kentucky after state’s prediction market lawsuits14m
on_the_radar.summary: The CFTC is taking legal action against the state of Kentucky following the state's own lawsuits against prediction markets. This highlights an escalating legal battle over the regulation of event contracts and prediction platforms.

on_the_radar.title: Senate Democrats urge Republicans to hold hearings on Trump family crypto ties to Abu Dhabi royalty
on_the_radar.summary: Senate Democrats are requesting congressional hearings to investigate the crypto ventures of the Trump family and their ties to Abu Dhabi royalty. The move focuses on potential conflicts of interest and the nature of these international digital asset partnerships.

on_the_radar.title: Zcash miner Fortitude gets Nasdaq listing via HeartSciences merger24m
on_the_radar.summary: Zcash mining company Fortitude is achieving a Nasdaq listing through a merger with HeartSciences. This move bridges the gap between crypto mining operations and public equity markets.

on_the_radar.title: Meta's Zuckerberg wants to build prediction market app like Polymarket and Kalshi: NYT
on_the_radar.summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg is reportedly interested in developing a prediction market application similar to Polymarket and Kalshi. This move signals potential entry of a Big Tech giant into the prediction market space, which has seen significant growth in volume.

on_the_radar.title: Former BIS chief softens stance on stablecoins, backs coexistence with fiat22m
on_the_radar.summary: The former head of the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) has shifted his perspective on stablecoins, suggesting they can coexist with traditional fiat currencies. This represents a softening stance from a high-level global financial authority regarding the integration of digital assets into the monetary system.

worth_a_read.note: A practical case study on the operational scaling of a Web3 payments platform from incubation to global reach.

linkedin_post:
The 'institutionalization' of crypto is moving past simple spot ETFs. We are seeing a concerted push toward integrating blockchain primitives into the actual plumbing of global finance.

From Chainlink collaborating with European and South Korean banks on FX settlement to CBOE exploring crypto perpetuals, the focus has shifted to utility and sophisticated derivatives. Simultaneously, the distribution layer is expanding, as seen with USDT's integration into Brazil's PIX network, potentially reaching 170 million users. 

While the DOJ continues to prune the ecosystem of bad actors through high-profile seizures, the structural rails for institutional adoption are being laid in real-time. The thesis is clear: the winners will be those who bridge the gap between legacy financial efficiency and on-chain transparency.

Is the integration of stablecoins into national payment rails the ultimate catalyst for mass adoption, or will CBDCs crowd them out?
